decisions.reason: It kept a dedicated page in both 2023 and 2024, which suggests performance at or above aspiration and a strong fit with the firm’s core data- and platform-based offer.

Its downgrade from a standalone page to a website mention signals results somewhat below aspiration, but its close link to the core tariff and calculation business and likely low marginal support cost make continued retention more likely than immediate withdrawal.

Although it lost standalone prominence by 2024, it builds on the firm’s established capabilities and likely serves as a complementary tool within the broader platform, so available organizational slack supports keeping it for now.
